title: Data-Centric L-Diversity Model
summary: A data-centric L-diversity (DCLD) anonymization pipeline that pre-processes data and applies shallow anonymization, using synthetic data generation to fix class-imbalance in sensitive-attribute distributions before privacy-preserving generalization. It imports and runs the standalone CTGAN package (with the authors noting they used the open-source CTGAN implementation with slight modifications) to generate the balancing synthetic data.
evidence: Interface_Program_SD_Generation.py:4-5 'from ctgan import CTGAN' / 'from ctgan import load_demo'; footnote cites sdv-dev/CTGAN as modified basis
needs: Unclear whether the footnote's 'slight modifications' means vendored/modified CTGAN source or just parameter tuning of the imported package.
